method: Isolated Chrome DOM executing current loadGuardian/presentation observer with in-memory metadata; no auth or backend requests.
checks: Result counts derive only from safe metadata; getters for every candidate text field were never touched, enum values unchanged.
Summary and moved publish ARIA references resolve; native description list exposes count labels and values.
Native fixed action link focuses the tabindex=-1 publish heading in view.
Same-result presentation refresh preserves intentional publish-heading focus and does not mutate the shared live region.
Authoritative safe_description_count includes INTERRUPT and preserves an explicit zero instead of falling back.
Generated student identity checkbox labels remain verbatim even when they contain a mapped UI phrase.
Role switch to student restores original shared labels/code text and quick-command aria-label; replaced new student nodes remain intact.
Repeated guardian -> signed-out transition restores original labels without translation stacking.
Restoration preserves fresh same-text-node content written during a role transition.
Attribute restoration preserves a fresh aria-label written during the same role transition.
limitations: Parent separately tests real sample rendering and actual API workflow.
